inputs: a_buybacks.csv: code,amount_yuan,announce_date (A; 12m window vs snapshot date; both sides CNY)

lineage.source: Boudoukh, Michaely, Richardson, Roberts, On the Importance of Measuring Payout Yield (Journal of Finance 2007)
lineage.note: payout_yield_lb = 股息率 + 回购收益率(A股近12月公告额/市值); 净发行未量化 → 恒为下界 (lb 命名即声明)

limits: net issuance amount absent → value is a LOWER BOUND (named payout_yield_lb), never the full net payout
HK/US: dividend leg only, no buyback-amount source (payout_basis=dividend_only_no_buyback_source)
missing dividend_yield treated as 0 (no detected payout)
